name: Runner Extras - Static RunModal Record
brief: Regression for issue #1897: static Page.RunModal(id, Record) NREs at NCLMetaForm.CreateObjectInstance while the AL-page-variable form (P.SetRecord(Rec); P.RunModal();) already works. Also covers #1918: static Page.RunModal(0, Record) must resolve the page from the record's table's LookupPageId, same as real BC's NavForm.RunModalAsync.
description: The general BC-language contract this exercises — static Page.RunModal(id, Record) reaches a [ModalPageHandler], same as the page-variable form, and Page.RunModal(0, Record) resolves the page from the record's own table's LookupPageId — is a plain BC-behaviour claim and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); corpus tests/PRs for both were prepared alongside these fixes. This suite is the runner-repo-local stopgap: it pins the runner-INTERNAL defects directly (NCLMetaForm.CreateObjectInstance(NavRecord) NREing because the runner forces NCLMetaApplicationObject.ApplicationObjectConstructor to null for every object type, same story as the sibling NCLMetaXmlPort/NCLMetaQuery CreateObjectInstance fixes; and the runner's synthesized NCLMetaTable never populating LookupFormId from the AL-declared LookupPageId property), so this repo's own CI gates the fixes now, without waiting on the corpus PRs to merge and the submodule pin to bump. Once those upstream tests land and the pin moves, this suite's claims are fully covered there too and it may be retired.
